# Cutroom tools

<!-- Generated by `cutroom docs` from the CLI's own help text. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every command accepts `--help`. Commands with `--json` print one JSON object on stdout;
errors print a suggested fix and exit non-zero. Commands that act on a job append to
`jobs/<id>/log.md` and `jobs/<id>/logs/commands.jsonl`.

## `cutroom docs`

Regenerate docs/TOOLS.md from the commands' own help text.

Parameters:

- `--check`, `--no-check`: Exit 1 if docs/TOOLS.md is out of date instead of writing it.

## `cutroom doctor`

Check the whole toolchain on this machine and write config/machine.json.

Detects OS, CPU, RAM, GPU and FFmpeg capabilities, tests hardware encoders,
then ingests, proxies and transcribes a bundled clip and checks the words and
timings against its known script. Exit code 0 means everything works.

Parameters:

- `--quick`, `--no-quick`: Skip the end-to-end ingest/proxy/transcribe smoke test.
- `--select-asr`: Benchmark speech models on this machine and pick the best that fits.
- `--asr-model`: Force a speech model (see `cutroom models list`).
- `--download`, `--no-download`: Download the chosen speech model if missing.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom ingest`

Probe, hash and register footage in a job. Originals are never modified.

By default files are copied into jobs/<id>/source/ (read-only) so the job is
self-contained. Identical files (same hash) are detected and skipped.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `PATHS...` (optional): Files or folders. Default: files already in jobs/<id>/source/.
- `--reference`: Read files in place instead of copying them into the job (saves disk; breaks if files move).
- `--role`: Role for these files: main, broll, music, sfx, voiceover, image.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom jobs`

List jobs.

Parameters:

- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom machine`

Show the machine profile (hardware, chosen models, encoders, concurrency).

Parameters:

- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom models list`

List available speech models, their size, licence and download state.

Parameters:

- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom models pull`

Download a speech model (pinned revision) into models/asr/.

Parameters:

- `NAME`: Model name, e.g. small.en
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom new`

Create a job workspace: jobs/<job-id>/ with brief.md, log.md and stage folders.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: New job id, e.g. acme-launch-video
- `--client`: Client name (selects styles/clients/<client>.style.yaml later).
- `--title`: Working title.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom probe`

Inspect a media file (streams, fps, VFR, HDR, rotation, duration) without ingesting it.

Parameters:

- `PATH`: Media file to inspect.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom proxy`

Make constant-frame-rate proxies and extract audio (16 kHz WAV for ASR, 48 kHz FLAC for analysis).

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--source`, `-s`: Source id(s), e.g. S01. Default: all.
- `--short-side`: Proxy short side in pixels (default from machine profile, 540).
- `--force`, `--no-force`: Rebuild even if up to date.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom status`

Show a job's sources, derived files and stage status.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom transcribe`

Transcribe sources locally with word-level timestamps.

Writes analysis/<source>/transcript.json (words, times, confidence),
transcript.txt (timestamped reading view; doubtful words marked) and
transcript.srt. Runs `proxy` audio extraction first if needed.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--source`, `-s`: Source id(s), e.g. S01. Default: all.
- `--model`: Override the speech model from the machine profile.
- `--hotword`: Names/terms to bias recognition toward (repeatable).
- `--verbatim`, `--no-verbatim`: Keep fillers, stumbles and repetitions (needed for cutting them).
- `--force`, `--no-force`: Re-transcribe even if a transcript exists.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom version`

Print the Cutroom version.
